top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks unite a distinct quantum-control principle with defining high-performance realization and independent reproducibility. Katori and Ye provide the most coherent, narrowly framed conceptual-and-experimental attribution; the award should remain confined to the invention and realization of optical lattice clocks.
recusal_note: No direct connection to Katori or Ye is apparent from the supplied profile. As director of WACQT, I have a general professional connection to quantum computing, but no direct connection to the named laureates of this proposal is apparent.
